articles.title: Bitcoin rebounds above $60,000 after $1.8 billion crypto liquidation wave
articles.summary: The selloff wiped out $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly from bullish bets on rising prices.

articles.title: GTA 6 Leaker Dangles a PC Port Behind a $15 Million Crypto Pump
articles.summary: The anonymous leaker, Cyberleek, released a 209 GB Xbox build but is withholding the executable that could enable a PC port until its CYBERLEEK token hits $15 million.

articles.title: Review: Godzilla Minus Zero joins the list of truly stellar sequels
